reported_actual_evidence.evidence_limit: These actual metadata were supplied by Root. This source review did not inspect cache DB contents, recursively rescan the bundle, or establish the precise OS writer.

confirmed_source_chain.finding: Managed Core environment is rebuilt from a case-normalized allowlist. SystemDrive is absent even when the parent environment supplies it.
Core spawn receives the filtered environment and options.cwd verbatim.
Main explicitly selects cwd=REPO. Packaged layout makes REPO the sealed bundle root.
Native folder choice initializes COM and calls SHBrowseForFolderW within Core itself, using Core process environment/cwd.
The already registered public controller template also omits SystemDrive and launches Electron with cwd=bundle.bundle.
The standard launcher also rebuilds an environment without SystemDrive, and uses the bundle cwd. It is outside the proposed minimal slice.
The separate Go Harness child environment also omits SystemDrive. This is not the direct path of the in-Core folder Shell UI and remains outside this minimal slice.

rootcause_assessment.source_defect_confirmed: SystemDrive is dropped from managed Core environment.
rootcause_assessment.causal_inference: A Windows Shell component using an unexpanded %SystemDrive%-based cache location could treat the literal path as relative to Core cwd, explaining the new prefix beneath the bundle after folder choice.
rootcause_assessment.not_proven: No OS expansion API, Shell action, cache DB parser or process-write tracer was run. The exact internal expansion call and writer are not independently established.

cwd_migration_blocker.decision: Keep Core cwd unchanged in this slice. Moving it to dataRoot would break real startup until a separately scoped absolute-resource change and prelaunch directory lifecycle exist. Do not copy contracts into user data or weaken resource validation as a workaround.

changes: Validate the selected case-normalized SystemRoot as a nonempty drive-rooted Windows system path, rejecting relative/UNC/device/unexpanded/NUL values; if WINDIR is also supplied require the same normalized system directory.
Derive exactly one canonical SystemDrive such as C: from that validated SystemRoot volume. Never derive from D: bundle/dataRoot/cwd and never copy ambient SystemDrive.
Preserve sensitive-variable filtering, case-collision rejection, explicit owned data/web/listen overrides and all Native identity/pipe/Job/stop checks.
Keep Core cwd and installed-resource resolution unchanged.
preconditions: Root registers a new isolated worktree/scope and exact baseline pins before D writes.

The validation behavior for absent/invalid SystemRoot is explicit and fail-closed before spawn; update existing synthetic environment fixtures with a valid public OS root while preserving their original optional-home/PATH assertions.
Existing old bundle, diagnostic03, listed/unlisted guard and all old source/evidence freezes remain immutable.

tests_after_lease: Actual managedControlEnvironment: SystemRoot=C:\Windows and bundle/dataRoot D: derives SystemDrive=C:.
Malicious ambient SystemDrive/alternate case values cannot override the derived drive; ambient API keys, proxy, NODE_OPTIONS, CODEX_HOME and RESEARCHOS overrides remain dropped.
Mixed-case SystemRoot works; duplicates, conflicting WINDIR, missing/relative/UNC/device/NUL/unexpanded roots fail safely.
Existing managed-environment and relevant pure startup/management compatibility remain intact. No Native Shell UI or model execution is part of author tests.
separate_controller_change: Root should copy to a new controller revision, derive SystemDrive from the same validated public SystemRoot and set Electron launch cwd=the owned existing run_root. Core still has Main's explicit REPO cwd; do not claim full Core cwd isolation. Use a fresh valid bundle; never relax BUNDLE_UNLISTED_PATH or delete the poisoned old bundle.
